message.entry: comp.tab_parameter.base and comp.para_base are deprecated: the nominal frequency is held by the network. Read it with comp.r_Hz, or read and set it with net.tab_parameter.base.Hz.
Setting comp.tab_parameter.base.Hz or comp.para_base.Hz is deprecated: it now sets the frequency of the whole network {0} to {1} Hz. Use net.tab_parameter.base.Hz = value.
Component {0} is not attached to a network, so its frequency cannot be set. The frequency is held by the network: use net.tab_parameter.base.Hz = value.
The add_bus option baseMVA is deprecated and ignored: the system base is net.tab_parameter.base.baseMVA ({0} MVA).

The add_bus option baseMVA is deprecated and ignored: the given {0} MVA differs from the system base net.tab_parameter.base.baseMVA = {1} MVA, which is used. Set net.tab_parameter.base.baseMVA instead.
The positional mode argument of calculate_powerflow is deprecated: use net.calculate_powerflow(Method="{0}").

The calculate_powerflow options export and filename are deprecated: use net.calculate_powerflow(Export=filename) or result.Export(filename). A .json file holds the iteration history; a relative file name is now relative to the current folder.
The optimize_powerflow option methods is deprecated: use net.optimize_powerflow(Method="{0}").
The build_opf_problem option methods is deprecated: use net.build_opf_problem(Method="{0}").

The 6-output form [powerflow_bus, powerflow_cub, flag, output, lambda, OPFprob] = net.optimize_powerflow(...) is deprecated: use [result, flag, output] = net.optimize_powerflow(...) and result.tab_bus, result.tab_cub, result.lambda, result.OPFprob.

Continuation_Power_Flow(net, opt) is deprecated: use [result, flag] = net.calculate_continuation_powerflow(LoadBus=opt.CPFBus). The v3 options map to LoadBus, InitialLambda, MaxIteration, StepSize, ArcLength and UseInternalState; result.rm_x is the old CPF_Result.x_sol.

ContinuationPowerFlow(net, Name, Value) is removed: the solver no longer holds the network or its result, and ContinuationPowerFlow() takes no arguments. Use [result, flag] = net.calculate_continuation_powerflow(LoadBus=...) (defaults in net.solver_CPF), or the deprecated wrapper Continuation_Power_Flow(net, opt) for the v3 usage.

CsvNetHandler.import(path, net) is deprecated: use net = PowerNetwork.import_csv(path) for a new network, or PowerNetwork.import_csv(path, Network=obj) to load into an existing one (e.g. in the constructor of a network class).
CsvNetHandler.export(net, ModelName, savepath=folder) is deprecated: use net.export_csv(fullfile(folder, "@"+ModelName)). The folder now also holds network/parameter.csv with Hz and baseMVA.
net.solver_ODE.Reporter is deprecated: use net.solver_ODE.Progress ("none", "disp" or "dialog"), or net.simulate(..., Progress=value) for one call.
The simulate option {0} is deprecated: use {1}.

odeLinearizer(net, NonUnit, Name, Value) is removed: the solver no longer holds the network or its matrices, and odeLinearizer() takes no arguments. Use result = net.linearize(NonUnit=..., Algorithm=...) and sys = result.get_ss() (defaults in net.solver_LIN), or sys = net.get_sys(...).
